mapper.sql: FROM branch b JOIN partner p ON b.p_idx = p.p_idx
mapper.select:
SELECT b.b_idx, b.p_idx, b.b_name, b.b_description, b.b_file, b.b_address, b.b_latitude, b.b_altitude, b.b_phone, b.b_sns, b.b_hours, b.b_notice, b.b_refund_policy, p.p_name
/* 지점 전체 목록은 기본적으로 인덱스 순 정렬 */ ORDER BY b.b_idx ASC

SELECT b.b_idx, b.p_idx, b.b_name, b.b_description, b.b_file, b.b_address, b.b_latitude, b.b_altitude, b.b_phone, b.b_sns, b.b_hours, b.b_notice, b.b_refund_policy, p.p_name
WHERE b.b_idx = #{brnIdx}

SELECT b.b_idx, b.p_idx, b.b_name, b.b_description, b.b_file, b.b_address, b.b_latitude, b.b_altitude, b.b_phone, b.b_sns, b.b_hours, b.b_notice, b.b_refund_policy, p.p_name
JOIN space s ON s.b_idx = b.b_idx WHERE s.s_idx = #{sIdx}
